title: Passé composé with avoir
summary: Form the passé composé with avoir + past participle for most verbs. Regular -ER → -é, -IR → -i, -RE → -u. Many common verbs have irregular participles (fait, pris, vu, écrit).
full_explanation: Form the passé composé with avoir + past participle for most verbs. Regular -ER → -é, -IR → -i, -RE → -u. Many common verbs have irregular participles (fait, pris, vu, écrit). Learn meanings before drilling forms. Say each example aloud. Contrast English word order with French when helpful. Reuse the same lemmas in reading, dialogue, and exercises. Avoid story-memory quizzes — test forms and meanings only. When unsure, reopen the Words to learn first list in the lesson brief. Register matters: vous with strangers, tu with friends who offered it. Silent letters and liaison appear often; listen and repeat. Spiral earlier tools into new sentences.
